features.feature_summary: FHIR stores can now export resource changes to BigQuery on create, update, patch, and delete events using a new streamConfigs field.
features.extended_definition: FHIR stores can now export resource changes to BigQuery on create, update, patch, and delete events using a new streamConfigs field.

features.feature_name: HL7v2 store multi-topic Pub/Sub notifications
features.feature_summary: HL7v2 stores can now be configured with multiple Pub/Sub topics and message filters to route notifications to different topics.
features.extended_definition: HL7v2 stores can now be configured with multiple Pub/Sub topics and message filters to route notifications to different topics.

features.feature_name: executeBundle audit logging
features.feature_summary: Execution of the executeBundle operation now emits logging records.
features.extended_definition: Execution of the executeBundle operation now emits logging records.

features.feature_name: FHIR store access control changes
features.feature_summary: FHIR store permission rules were updated so API-level access no longer implies configuration read access and executeBundle no longer implies create, update, delete, or get permissions.
features.extended_definition: FHIR store permission rules were updated so API-level access no longer implies configuration read access and executeBundle no longer implies create, update, delete, or get permissions.

features.feature_name: FHIR store version support
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API FHIR stores now support the major FHIR release versions DSTU2, STU3, and R4 during creation.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API FHIR stores now support the major FHIR release versions DSTU2, STU3, and R4 during creation.

features.feature_name: Filter-based de-identification for DICOM and FHIR
features.feature_summary: The API introduced filter-based de-identification options for both DICOM and FHIR data.
features.extended_definition: The API introduced filter-based de-identification options for both DICOM and FHIR data.

features.feature_name: Store-level DICOM/FHIR de-identification
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API added support for configuring de-identification at the individual DICOM and FHIR store level.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API added support for configuring de-identification at the individual DICOM and FHIR store level.

features.feature_name: Single-region expansion to asia-southeast1 and us-west2
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API added single-region availability in Singapore (asia-southeast1) and Los Angeles (us-west2).
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API added single-region availability in Singapore (asia-southeast1) and Los Angeles (us-west2).

features.feature_name: Cloud Healthcare API gcloud beta commands
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API tooling support was added to the Google Cloud CLI (gcloud) beta commands.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API tooling support was added to the Google Cloud CLI (gcloud) beta commands.

features.feature_name: DICOM de-identification UID preservation option
features.feature_summary: DICOM de-identification gained an option to avoid automatically regenerating UIDs such as StudyInstanceUID, SeriesInstanceUID, and SOPInstanceUID.
features.extended_definition: DICOM de-identification gained an option to avoid automatically regenerating UIDs such as StudyInstanceUID, SeriesInstanceUID, and SOPInstanceUID.

features.feature_name: Single-region expansion to asia-northeast1
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API added single-region availability in the asia-northeast1 (Tokyo) region.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API added single-region availability in the asia-northeast1 (Tokyo) region.

features.feature_name: Single-region expansion to europe-west4
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API added single-region availability in europe-west4 (Netherlands).
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API added single-region availability in europe-west4 (Netherlands).

features.feature_name: Multi-region expansion to us
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API added multi-region service availability for the US (united states) location.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API added multi-region service availability for the US (united states) location.

features.feature_name: Lossless DICOM de-identification output support
features.feature_summary: DICOM de-identification now supports lossless image output quality when lossless input formats are provided.
features.extended_definition: DICOM de-identification now supports lossless image output quality when lossless input formats are provided.

features.feature_name: and FHIR stores
features.feature_summary: User labels were added to DICOM, HL7v2, and FHIR stores to support resource filtering and billing charge views by label.
features.extended_definition: User labels were added to DICOM, HL7v2, and FHIR stores to support resource filtering and billing charge views by label.

features.feature_name: Cloud Healthcare API
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API was announced in public beta as a managed Google Cloud platform for storing and accessing healthcare data.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API was announced in public beta as a managed Google Cloud platform for storing and accessing healthcare data.

features.feature_name: Cloud Healthcare API Google Cloud Console UI
features.feature_summary: The Google Cloud Console gained a user interface for managing Cloud Healthcare datasets and stores, permissions, and long-running operations.
features.extended_definition: The Google Cloud Console gained a user interface for managing Cloud Healthcare datasets and stores, permissions, and long-running operations.

features.feature_name: DICOM fuzzy patient-name matching
features.feature_summary: DICOM search now supports fuzzy matching on patient names.
features.extended_definition: DICOM search now supports fuzzy matching on patient names.

features.feature_name: DICOM QIDO-RS result pagination
features.feature_summary: The DICOM QIDO-RS API now supports paginated query results.
features.extended_definition: The DICOM QIDO-RS API now supports paginated query results.

features.feature_name: DICOM transfer syntax transcoding expansion
features.feature_summary: DICOM transcoding support was expanded to additional transfer syntaxes, including lossless JPEG.
features.extended_definition: DICOM transcoding support was expanded to additional transfer syntaxes, including lossless JPEG.

features.feature_name: DICOMweb performance improvements
features.feature_summary: DICOMweb performance in Cloud Healthcare API was improved.
features.extended_definition: DICOMweb performance in Cloud Healthcare API was improved.

features.feature_name: Expanded DICOM/FHIR de-identification configuration
features.feature_summary: Cloud Healthcare API introduced additional de-identification configuration options for DICOM and FHIR data, including more control over resource handling.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Healthcare API introduced additional de-identification configuration options for DICOM and FHIR data, including more control over resource handling.

features.feature_name: HL7v2
features.feature_summary: User labels were added to DICOM, HL7v2, and FHIR stores to support resource filtering and billing charge views by label.
features.extended_definition: User labels were added to DICOM, HL7v2, and FHIR stores to support resource filtering and billing charge views by label.

features.feature_name: Single-part DICOM STOW-RS requests
features.feature_summary: The API now supports single-part STOW-RS requests to avoid client-side multipart header handling.
features.extended_definition: The API now supports single-part STOW-RS requests to avoid client-side multipart header handling.

features.feature_name: Single-part DICOM WADO-RS requests
features.feature_summary: The API now supports single-part WADO-RS requests to avoid client-side multipart header handling.
features.extended_definition: The API now supports single-part WADO-RS requests to avoid client-side multipart header handling.

features.feature_name: User labels for DICOM
features.feature_summary: User labels were added to DICOM, HL7v2, and FHIR stores to support resource filtering and billing charge views by label.
features.extended_definition: User labels were added to DICOM, HL7v2, and FHIR stores to support resource filtering and billing charge views by label.
